prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1335; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported acute low back pain with muscle spasm and limited lumbar range of motion. Neurological examination was within normal limits, with no radicular symptoms, no motor or sensory deficits, and negative straight leg raise bilaterally. Imaging was not indicated at initial presentation given the clinical findings.

Over the course of eight visits, the patient received a combination of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise focused on core stabilization and lumbar mobility, and instruction in activity modification and ergonomic posture. Pain levels improved steadily from the initial presentation, and lumbar range of motion increased toward functional limits by the later visits. Muscle spasm resolved on palpation at the most recent visit.

Diagnosis at discharge remains lumbar strain, resolving. The patient is advised to continue a home exercise program, avoid heavy lifting until fully cleared, and return if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop. Prognosis is good with continued self-management.
